executive_pulse: Active exploitation campaigns target Azure API Management and Cisco Expressway, with threat actors extracting customer API secrets and obtaining root access. CISA added N-able MailAssure and Project MONAI flaws to KEV following confirmed zero-day abuse.

items.headline: Azure API Management Flaw Exploited to Exfiltrate Customer API Credentials
items.target: Microsoft / Azure API Management / Classic Tiers
items.summary: Threat actors actively exploited a security vulnerability in Microsoft Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers to steal stored API credentials, access tokens, and named values, impacting European critical infrastructure and energy sector entities.
items.action: Audit APIM Classic instances, immediately rotate all stored API keys, certificates, and secrets, and upgrade to managed APIM tiers.
items.hunt: Azure Activity Logs: anomalous calls to APIM access token generation, export operations, or unexpected modifications of named values.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: N-able MailAssure LDAP SSRF Added to CISA KEV Following Cloud Breach
items.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) in N-able MailAssure LDAP synchronization allowed authenticated API users to probe internal network topology and send payload data to internal services. Discovered during an investigation into an MSP cloud service breach.
items.action: Apply vendor updates for MailAssure, isolate API endpoints, and audit internal network connections originated by MailAssure hosts.
items.hunt: MailAssure API logs: LDAP sync connection requests targeting RFC1918 internal IPs, loopback addresses, or non-standard internal ports.

compensating_controls: Restrict the server's outbound traffic to required destinations only
Block access to cloud instance metadata from the application (for example IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 on AWS)
remediation.verify: Review egress and metadata-service access logs from the affected host

items.headline: Project MONAI MONAI Label Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Write Exploited
items.summary: Path traversal vulnerability in Project MONAI MONAI Label allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write arbitrary files outside the datastore directory, enabling remote code execution. Added to CISA KEV due to active exploitation.
items.action: Apply pull request #1915 or security advisories for MONAILabel and restrict network access to labeling server instances.
items.hunt: MONAI Label HTTP server logs: requests containing directory traversal patterns (../ or encoded variants) targeting file upload endpoints.

compensating_controls: Remove internet exposure of the affected interface until patched
Apply WAF or IPS signatures from your vendor for the CVE, in blocking mode
Run the service as a non-privileged user and restrict outbound connections
remediation.verify: Hunt for shells or scripting engines spawned by the affected service, and new scheduled tasks or cron entries

items.headline: OpenMind-Jailbreak-Lab: LLM Security Testing Framework
items.summary: An open-source AI security lab designed for reproducible adversarial testing, jailbreak resistance evaluation, and LLM guardrail validation across multiple AI model providers.
items.action: Review source code and execute jailbreak evaluation suites in isolated test environments to benchmark LLM guardrail resilience.
